name: agent-native
description: A framework for building agentic apps
one_liner: A developer toolkit for building apps where an AI assistant and the regular on-screen buttons do the exact same things, so an app and its built-in AI helper never fall out of sync.
buyer: A SaaS founder or CTO who wants to bolt a genuinely useful AI assistant onto their product without maintaining two separate, drifting code paths.
business_use_cases: A project-management tool adds 'ask the assistant to move this task to next sprint' by wiring the same action the drag-and-drop UI already calls.
An internal ops team builds a dashboard where staff can click through screens or just tell an agent to do the same task.
An agency ships client MVPs faster by starting from one of the bundled example agent apps (Clips, Design, Slides) as a starting template.

money_ideas.idea: Build a vertical SaaS product (an agent-native CRM, support desk, or scheduling tool) on top of the framework.
Offer 'add an AI copilot to your existing app' as a fixed-scope implementation service for other startups.

steal_this: Clone the included Slides example app, re-skin it for a specific niche like real-estate listing decks, and sell weekend access as a subscription tool.
